title: Warm Gooey Italian Paneer Lasagna
description: A halal-friendly Italian dish featuring paneer, nuka-pickle, and rich umami flavors, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped nuka-pickle until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, crumbled paneer, grated parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Spread a layer of marinara sauce at the bottom of a 20x20cm baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta-paneer mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the marinara sauce, the remaining ricotta-paneer mixture, and finally the remaining mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh basil over the top layer of mozzarella cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
